about: Georgian Bluffs is a township in Grey County, Ontario, on Georgian Bay west of Owen Sound—not a city. Escarpment bluffs, shoreline communities, and rural inland farms share a long bayfront territory including areas toward Wiarton approaches. About 11,000 people live in Georgian Bluffs.
